# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/freeplan964-cmd/Mobil-Oil-EG/security/advisories/new) to provide reproduction details privately.

Include the affected route or component, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation. Do not include real credentials, personal data, or production secrets.

## Supported versions

The default branch is the supported version. Security fixes are applied to the latest maintained code.
